features: coupled loaded high-speed motor operating point
original ODE residual and local connected-machine stability gates
viscous/quadratic/smooth-friction shaft loads and absolute load step
limitations: bounded local equilibrium search; no uniqueness/global stability proof
local stability concerns connected machine states, not the whole hybrid protection system
smooth friction is not hard stiction/gravity/constant-power mechanics
no mixed synchronous-machine/motor DAE or VFD
synthetic parameters and cases; no target equipment validation
